text:
Alex Kim: Scheduling a global office hours session next Thurs. Need to confirm recording policy, clip pipeline, and lead routing for replay views. Quick sync?

Priya Shah: Legal: public reuse requires explicit release from speakers. Internal use is fine under standard webinar terms. For paid promos we need a checkbox or signed approval.

Marco Ruiz: Ops: plan to enable Zoom cloud recording + transcripts, export MP4 + VTT to our S3 bucket. I'll make a meeting template with host-only recording and disable local recording.

Jenna Lee: From production: please auto-export VTT and SRT. Also want automated 30s and 60s clip creation + thumbnails. I can build the clipper if infra provides bucket + role.

Omar Patel: I'll provision s3://redwood-assets/webinars/2026-12-09-global-officehours and create an IAM role. Suggest folder layout:
```
/full_recording.mp4
/transcript.vtt
/clips/30s/{utc}_{speaker}_{idx}.mp4
/clips/60s/{utc}_{speaker}_{idx}.mp4
/thumbnails/{utc}.png
/metadata/{utc}_clips.csv
```
Include clip start/end and UTM in metadata.

Lina Torres: Lead routing: set HubSpot rule: if replay_watch_pct >= 50 and domain != @redwood.com, advance lifecycle to MQL. Use UTM to split paid vs organic nurture.

Alex Kim: Priya, can Legal add a one-click speaker release to the panelist invite? Short language: "I grant Redwood permission to use short clips of this session for marketing (including paid ads)."

Priya Shah: Yes. Add checkbox + link to full release. Also add EU privacy copy on the registration page: "This session will be recorded and may be used for marketing clips. By registering you consent to this use."

Marco Ruiz: I'll send the Zoom template link in #eng-infra and attach it to the meeting. Template will enable cloud recording and transcript.

Jenna Lee: Clip pipeline I propose: Zoom -> S3 raw -> Lambda trigger -> FFMPEG renders clips (30s/60s) + thumbnails + optional burnt-in captions -> write metadata CSV. I'll own the Lambda and ops runbook if Omar shares the role.

Omar Patel: IAM role and bucket created. DM'ed Jenna the role ARN.

Lina Torres: UTM schema for clips: utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=clip&utm_campaign=global_officehours_20261209&utm_content={clip_variant}. I'll wire events into HubSpot.

Alex Kim: Quick checklist:
- [ ] Speaker release checkbox (Priya)
- [ ] Zoom template (Marco)
- [ ] S3 + IAM (Omar)
- [ ] Lambda clipper + runbook (Jenna)
- [ ] UTM mapping + HubSpot rule (Lina)
- [ ] EU registration privacy copy (Priya)

Priya Shah: I'll draft the checkbox copy and registration line by EOD.

Marco Ruiz: Template ready and shared.

Omar Patel: Bucket and role are live.

Jenna Lee: Will ship the Lambda tomorrow, ops doc included.

Lina Torres: HubSpot rule configured for watch_pct threshold and UTMs.

Alex Kim: Great. Proceeding unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:

Zoom Bot: Recording processed and exported to s3://redwood-assets/webinars/2026-12-09-global-officehours/full_recording.mp4 with transcript at transcript.vtt.
